landmarks.name: Renda Lutheran Church
landmarks.desc: Historic stone and timber Lutheran church standing at the heart of Renda since 1786.

landmarks.name: Īvandes Rumba Waterfall
landmarks.desc: Scenic limestone cascade on the Īvande River just east of Renda's center.

landmarks.name: Valdātu Rumba Waterfall
landmarks.desc: Lower stepped cascade along the Īvande valley trail.

landmarks.name: Velna Laiva (Devil's Boat)
landmarks.desc: Ancient Nordic-style stone ship burial formation overlooking the valley.

landmarks.name: Rendas Pilskalns (Hillfort)
landmarks.desc: Ancient Couronian fortified hillfort perched above the Abava and Īvande confluence.

landmarks.name: Lielrenda Manor
landmarks.desc: Former estate of Groß-Rönnen surrounded by centuries-old park oaks.

landmarks.name: Duke's Hunting Lodge Ruins
landmarks.desc: Stone ruins linked to Duke Jacob of Courland's royal hunting grounds.

landmarks.name: Abavas Laivas Pier
landmarks.desc: Traditional wooden canoe landing along the pearl of Kurzeme.

landmarks.name: Abavas Pagrabiņš Tavern
landmarks.desc: Local gathering spot and traveler stop in the center of Renda.

landmarks.name: Vini Curlandia Vineyard
landmarks.desc: Kurzeme craft winery nestled on the sunlit Abava valley slope.
